## Positioning
FilmCraft Use edits video as a native, reopenable project rather than a rendered file. It probes you
r media, assembles tracks on an exact integer tick base, keeps voice-over, music and source audio se
parate, treats captions as editable text with timing and style, and finishes only after the exported
file has been decoded and checked for duration, size and audio.
The plugin plans and verifies; the pinned FilmCraft CLI performs the native edit. Long-form command
coverage, physical GUI input and other platforms are not qualified, and every write must stay inside
the read and write roots you explicitly authorize.

## Architecture and security
- Root isolation is enforced for macOS headless execution. The desktop entry must additionally isola
te the signed app it owns and expose only its assigned loopback control port; an external bridge tha

t cannot prove isolation is refused.
- Media, music and voice are separate identities with separate

gains. Voices are never synthesized or uploaded without authorization.
- Writes require `--save` or
`--save-as`, or one `run`/MCP session. A timeout never proves that no side effect happened: check th

e project, the export or the task first.
